message:
I see the `get_opt` function. It uses `sword[MAX_CR_ESCAPE]` and does `strncpy(sword+1, start_of_word, word_len)` and `sword[word_len+1] = '\0'`. If `word_len` is >= MAX_CR_ESCAPE, this would be a buffer overflow. Let me check what MAX_CR_ESCAPE is:

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>grep -n "MAX_CR_ESCAPE" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4/src/*.h /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4/src/*.c | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
